def roll(g):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); comps=[(g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]],cells) for cells in components(g)]
 while True:
  changed=False
  for color,cells in comps:
   positions=set(cells)
   dest={(r,c+1) for r,c in cells}
   if max(c for r,c in cells)>=w-1 or any(g[r][c] and (r,c) not in positions for r,c in dest): continue
   for r,c in cells:g[r][c]=0
   cells[:]=[(r,c+1) for r,c in cells]
   for r,c in cells:g[r][c]=color
   changed=True
  if not changed:break
 return g
